subject: Fourier robustness heat maps — kickoff
body:
Hi Alina,

Kicking off the Fourier robustness work. The method generates Fourier heat maps of image classifiers: we add frequency basis vectors to input images and visualize how layer outputs and test error respond across the frequency spectrum. Product angle: a robustness report card that becomes part of the model release checklist for the vision portfolio — today we have no systematic view of which models fall over on high-frequency perturbations.

Milestones: wrap our classifiers behind the TensorFlowNeuralNetwork interface by Jun 12, heat maps for the flagship classifiers by mid-July, robustness readout to Hana's staff in early August.

Milan, Katya and Freya are assigned. Alina, over to you for staffing and the data plan.

Lucia
